ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.4:0.6 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the total visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The left lobe (0-50% X-axis) is characterized by a contiguous high-intensity background containing discrete low-intensity circular focal spots. The right lobe (50-100% X-axis) consists of a dominant low-intensity block with high-intensity mottled clusters localized at the distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration map with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks (5-15 pixels) distributed along the continuous linear boundary of both lobes, particularly prominent on the distal edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Geometric curve following a convex sweep from the medial region transitioning to a concave trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed dark circular pixel clusters on the left lobe's high-intensity surface and small high-intensity pixel clusters on the right lobe's low-intensity distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of a single distinct, low-intensity linear pixel disruption (~40 pixels in length) on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosette patterns) across the left lobe and a highly irregular, jagged trailing edge profile indicating historical tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the left (high-intensity dominant) and right (low-intensity dominant) lobes.
